extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (Linux Desktop) (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for Linux Desktop. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an integrated watchdog thread with automatic interface and route recovery to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for Linux Desktop. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v1.0.6 (2026-09-22)
Fixed NM profile auto-activation during import: - NM activated new profiles before the add-on's suppression arrived. Profiles are now deactivated right after suppression. Zero active tunnels verified, clean state.
Resolved DNS leak: provider DNS from phantom tunnels eliminated by the import fix.
Rewrote settings-change update pipeline (service_updater.py): - Snapshot-difference gate, watchlist from provider map. - Prevents PIA pia_pass re-encryption loop. Verified: one run on real mutation only.
Added stream-aware tunnel recovery (tunnel_checker.py): - Tunnel loss during playback dispatches background reconnect helper; manual sessions no longer stall.
Hardened reconnect helper (reconnect_helper.py): - Profiles resolved via exact NM name or friendly-name lookup; returns to intended server. - PID instance lock: one helper regardless of dispatcher. Stress- verified: single-attempt recovery, no fighting connections.
Made country removal a real teardown (country_selector.py): - Removes NM profiles and configs, clears map slots, tears down active tunnel if needed; removed countries no longer resurrect.
Fixed nm_register_profile signature mismatch.
Removed obsolete force_reinstall setting.
